name: claude-crew
stderr:
cli.js [command]

Commands:
  cli.js setup                             Setup the project
  cli.js serve-mcp <config-path>           Serve the MCP server
  cli.js setup-db <config-path>            Setup the database
  cli.js clean                             Remove containers and volumes, revert
                                            to pre setup-db state
  cli.js create-snippet                    Create a snippet for Claude Desktop
  cli.js create-instruction <config-path>  Create instruction file from config

Options:
  --version  Show version number                                       [boolean]
  --help     Show help                                                 [boolean]
